title: Звірка та приймання пакета
fields_and_relations: Маніфест, вихідні назви, revision елементів, checksum і комплектність. Надходження, джерельний пакет, локальні ID та шифри, перевірки документації/згод, рішення і завдання.
required_interaction: Прийняти/повернути елементи; дефект або відсутня копія → завдання, не фальшивий успіх.

implementation.view_model: WF-04 sender reconciliation and exact-byte portable packages; WF-05 immutable receipt, research/session checks, documentation and individual consent review, per-item accept/restrict/defer/return, stable local IDs and archive codes, partial re-review and linked work items; duplicate import protection.
limitations: Browser-local portable package up to 32 MiB; manual file delivery, no shared server or network transport.
Incoming descriptions preserve source snapshots; canonical graph mapping and reconciliation belong to WF-07/08.
Consent evidence is reviewed by a person with a locator and scope; private evidence is not automatically imported and no O46/O47/publication grant is created.
Selected backup bytes are verified; physical storage independence remains user-declared.
implementation.state_storage: Shared browser store; lazily added versioned intake records preserve existing browser data.
permissions: media.write / physical.write / intake.send / intake.receive / legacy.write / legacy.review / capture.field, explicit archive grants
implementation.atomicity: Authorize and compare expected revision/package state; mutate clone; validate FK/type/version/hash; commit atomically.
